detail.title: A kind of vacuum holding means
detail.abstract: The utility model discloses a kind of vacuum holding means, belong to clamping technique field.The vacuum holding means：Some grooves are offered on adsorption plate, passage is offered in some grooves；Vacuum adsorption mechanism is connected with the passage opened up on adsorption plate；Some cushion block one end are movably arranged in some grooves, and arrangement position of some cushion blocks on adsorption plate matches with workpiece shapes；Sealing mechanism is connected with some cushion block other ends, and sealing mechanism forms a closing space on the supporting surface that some cushion blocks are constituted, and shape and the workpiece shapes of closing space match.The utility model vacuum holding means can adapt to the clamping of variously-shaped, various sizes sheet parts, and controllability is strong, and independent assortment, highly versatile uses flexible, low cost of manufacture.
assignees: 湖北三江航天红阳机电有限公司
